title: Counting vertices by part
statement: Let $r$ and $k$ be nonnegative integers, and let $R$ be a finite set of vertices partitioned into $2r$ parts, each with $k$ possible vertices. The sum, over all parts, of the number of vertices of $R$ in that part equals the total number of vertices in $R$.
hypotheses_covered: $R$ is a finite set of vertices indexed by a part among $2r$ parts and a position among $k$ positions
